name: Gia
self_text: Hi! I'm Gia, a Korean in my mid 20s. When I'm not on my PC, I love knitting because it's so relaxing. I'm looking to jump into some ranked matches in Tidewatch. I play a support role and prefer using voice chat only for communication. I'm available to play on Saturday morning or Sunday morning.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available either Saturday morning or Sunday morning, and you have to play a damage role or be flexible about your role. It's a deal-breaker unless you are into ranked matches. It would be a small bonus if you are into Tidewatch, but no big deal.
